# **Getting to the conference**

The conference will be hosted at the Linköping University campus, in Linköping. The venue building is called the **Key House** and it’s a short walk from the bus stop **Nobeltorget**. You can get bus no 4 from Linköping central station to Nobeltorget. The meeting will be in room **KY24**, which is on the ground floor, to the right-hand side after the entrance.

### Travel by bus from Linköping C to LiU campus
You can check bus departures [__here__](https://www.ostgotatrafiken.se/res-med-oss/sok-resa) or download the *ÖstgötaTrafiken* app, search for from your position to *Nobeltorget* (to go from the central train station, pick the bus stop *Linköpings resecentrum*).

<small>
**Note**: If you are using the translation function on the website, the bus stops might get translated as well. In that case Linköpings resecentrum will be translated to the equivalent of "Linköping Travel Center" and Nobelberget to the equivalent of "Nobel Square"!
</small>
:::
